:::{#exr-real-valued-practice}
#### Testing whether a price prediction is real-valued

A model predicts a house's price from three of its features,
stored in $\vx \in \reals^3$,
with the [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function)

$$
f(\vx) = 2 x_1 + 5 x_2 - x_3.
$$

Is $f$ [real-valued](#def-real-vector-valued)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Evaluate $f$ at one point,
and count the numbers in the result.

:::

:::
